description: This Java class, LiteralDDataHandler, extends AbstractDDataHandler to manage distributed data for literal string topics in a pub/sub system. It provides a constructor for instantiation and a static factory method to create an instance tied to an ActorSystem, including an override for approximate topic retrieval.

classes.name: LiteralDDataHandler
classes.description: A distributed collection handler for string data indexed by ActorRef, providing methods for creation and approximation of topics.

methods.name: LiteralDDataHandler
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the handler with configuration, actor reference factory, actor system, executor, and topic type.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate the handler using the provided ActorSystem, configuration, and topic type.

methods.name: approximate
methods.description: Returns the input topic string as its approximate representation.
